sourcesContent:
export const professionalJobs = [
  {
    id: "senior-frontend",
    company: "TechCorp Algérie",
    initials: "TC",
    color: "#1b2d52",
    title: "Senior Frontend Developer",
    location: "Alger",
    type: "Full-time",
    salary: "80,000–120,000 DA/mo",
    workMode: "Remote",
    tags: ["Remote", "New"],
    posted: "2 days ago",
    contract: "CDI",
    experience: "3+ years",
    deadline: "May 15, 2026",
    description:
      "We are looking for an experienced Frontend Developer to lead development of our customer-facing web applications and mentor junior developers.",
    responsibilities: [
      "Build and maintain React components for our SaaS platform",
      "Collaborate with UX/UI designers on new features",
      "Mentor junior developers and conduct code reviews",
      "Participate in technical planning and architecture decisions",
      "Write unit and integration tests",
    ],
    skills: ["React", "TypeScript", "Node.js", "REST APIs", "Git", "Figma"],
    offers: [
      "Fully remote work arrangement",
      "Salary range: 80,000–120,000 DA/month",
      "Training budget: 50,000 DA/year",
      "Health insurance coverage",
    ],
    aboutCompany:
      "Leading Algerian software company building digital products used by over 200,000 users nationwide.",
    industry: "Technology",
    employees: "50–200",
    founded: "2018",
  },
  {
    id: "ux-designer",
    company: "Djezzy Digital",
    initials: "DJ",
    color: "#7c3aed",
    title: "UX/UI Designer",
    location: "Oran",
    type: "Full-time",
    salary: "60,000–90,000 DA/mo",
    workMode: "Presential",
    tags: ["Presential"],
    posted: "4 days ago",
    contract: "CDI",
    experience: "2+ years",
    deadline: "Jun 1, 2026",
    description: "Join our design team to create intuitive digital experiences for millions of users.",
    responsibilities: ["Design user flows and wireframes", "Create high-fidelity prototypes in Figma"],
    skills: ["Figma", "UX Research", "Prototyping"],
    offers: ["Competitive salary", "Modern office in Oran"],
    aboutCompany: "Digital innovation arm of a leading telecom operator.",
    industry: "Telecom",
    employees: "200+",
    founded: "2015",
  },
  {
    id: "fullstack",
    company: "StartupDZ",
    initials: "SD",
    color: "#059669",
    title: "Full Stack Engineer",
    location: "Constantine",
    type: "Contract",
    salary: "Negotiable",
    workMode: "Remote",
    tags: ["Remote"],
    posted: "1 week ago",
    contract: "CDD",
    experience: "2+ years",
    deadline: "Jun 30, 2026",
    description: "Build MVP features end-to-end for an early-stage startup.",
    responsibilities: ["Develop APIs and frontend features", "Deploy to cloud infrastructure"],
    skills: ["React", "Node.js", "PostgreSQL"],
    offers: ["Equity options", "Flexible hours"],
    aboutCompany: "Fast-growing Algerian startup in the fintech space.",
    industry: "Fintech",
    employees: "10–50",
    founded: "2022",
  },
  {
    id: "civil-engineer",
    company: "BatiMat DZ",
    initials: "BM",
    color: "#b45309",
    title: "Civil Engineer",
    location: "Annaba",
    type: "Full-time",
    salary: "70,000 DA/mo",
    workMode: "Presential",
    tags: ["Presential"],
    posted: "3 days ago",
    contract: "CDI",
    experience: "3+ years",
    deadline: "May 20, 2026",
    description: "Oversee construction projects across eastern Algeria.",
    responsibilities: ["Site supervision", "Technical reporting"],
    skills: ["AutoCAD", "Project Management"],
    offers: ["Company vehicle", "Health insurance"],
    aboutCompany: "Construction and materials company operating in 12 wilayas.",
    industry: "Construction",
    employees: "100–500",
    founded: "2010",
  },
];

export function getJobById(id) {
  return professionalJobs.find((j) => j.id === id);
}
